summary: Custom templates are YAML in GitHub or GitLab repos; they need a token property with ui:field: AAPTokenField for AAP authentication, and should set ui:widget: hidden and ui:backstage.review.show: false so the token is hidden from users.
questions: How do I hide the AAP token in a custom portal template?
Where are custom self-service templates stored?
Token section for a custom self-service template

answer_card.title: Token field in a custom portal template
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  parameters:
    - properties:
        token:
          title: Token
          type: string
          description: Oauth2 token
          ui:field: AAPTokenField
          ui:widget: hidden
          ui:backstage:
            review:
              show: false
```
`AAPTokenField` supplies the AAP token used to launch the job; `ui:widget: hidden` and `review.show: false` keep it out of sight.
